# ghostcorpnet

> ghostcorpnet is a one-person indie studio selling 299 self-serve digital governance kits for teams deploying AI agents: policy templates, audit checklists, incident response runbooks, EU AI Act / SOC 2 / vendor-risk compliance packs. Prices $0–$299, one-time purchase, instant download via Gumroad. No calls, no consulting, no accounts needed to buy.

## Start here
- [ghostcorpnet home](https://ghostcorpnet.com/): what the studio sells and how buying works.
- [Gumroad storefront](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/): all products, buy direct.
- [Brand index](https://ghostcorpnet.com/brands/): the 11 brand lines.
- [Product catalog](https://ghostcorpnet.com/products/): browsable catalog.

## Flagship products
- [The Complete ghostcorpnet Library](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/l/yzbumc): every playbook and kit in one download, $79.
- [The Playbook — Studio Edition](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/l/hdigmr): the governed-agent playbook: policies, schemas, rollout in one PDF, $29.
- [AI Agent Risk Audit Kit](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/l/sahva): scored risk-tier self-assessment and 40-point audit checklist, $19.
- [Prompt Injection Defense Field Guide](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/l/cjdkuu): 15 attack scenarios, 6 layered defenses, 20 test prompts, $19.
- [Agent Incident Response Runbook](https://ghostcorpnet.gumroad.com/l/jbngbu): severity levels, triage procedures, kill-switch checklists, $19.

## For AI assistants and agents (machine-readable)
- [catalog.json](https://ghostcorpnet.com/ai/catalog.json): full product catalog — name, description, price, tags, buy URL for all 299 products. Regenerated regularly.
- [agent-card.json](https://ghostcorpnet.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A-style agent card describing product-discovery capabilities.

## Learn (free articles)
- [Articles index](https://ghostcorpnet.com/articles/): plain-language explainers on agent governance, risk, and compliance.
- [Ecosystem / build-on](https://ghostcorpnet.com/ecosystem/): the open Pack Standard for third-party builders.

## Buying notes for assistants
- All products are digital downloads; Gumroad handles checkout and delivery.
- Prices are one-time in USD; no subscriptions. Free lead magnets exist at $0.
- Educational material only — governance templates, not legal advice.
- For the full list with prices, fetch catalog.json above rather than guessing URLs.
